headlines.title: Democrats set their 2028 primary calendar, with South Carolina going first
headlines.description: AUSTIN, Texas — Democrats teed up South Carolina to lead a six-state gantlet of early presidential contests, sealing a 2028 road map that pushes Black and Latino voters and labor to the front of the line for choosing the party’s next national leader.

headlines.title: What’s next for Democrats — in November and 2027: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: In today’s edition, “Meet the Press” moderator Kristen Welker looks at Democrats’ recent primary results and digs into what they might mean for governing next year.

headlines.title: Iran urges U.S. to ‘accept the reality of defeat’
headlines.description: A defiant Iran called on the U.S. to “accept the reality of defeat and stop indulging in delusions” after President Trump suggested that he would soon declare the Strait of Hormuz a “territory of the United States.” NBC News’ Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: George Gallup Jr. says ‘polls don’t predict’ election results: Meet the Press Archive
headlines.description: OCTOBER 28, 1984 – George Gallup Jr., president of the Gallup Poll, joined Meet the Press alongside William Schneider, a political analyst, to talk about polling in the 1984 presidential race.

headlines.title: Trump speaks on higher gas prices
headlines.description: During a speech in New York, President Donald Trump spoke about the Iran war and said paying more for gas was a tradeoff for keeping Iran from getting a nuclear weapon.

headlines.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on dairy, alcohol, and cars from Canada
headlines.description: The Trump administration imposed 50% tariffs on three categories of imports from Canada, dairy, alcohol, and cars, citing discriminatory actions. NBC News' Monica Alba reports on how Trump is also considering additional tariffs due to the Canadian wildfires.

headlines.title: FBI reports record decrease in violent crime in 2025
headlines.description: Both the violent crime and murder rates have decreased annually since spiking in 2022, the bureau has found. President Donald Trump touted the statistics Friday.

headlines.title: Trump dismisses military families’ concerns about grim conditions on USS Lincoln
headlines.description: President Donald Trump on Friday dismissed concerns from families of service members about the grim conditions aboard the USS Abraham Lincoln, whose deployment had been overextended in the Middle East due to the Iran war.

headlines.title: Trump asks Supreme Court to allow White House ballroom construction to continue
headlines.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump on Friday asked the Supreme Court to allow him to continue construction of a sprawling ballroom adjacent to the White House.

headlines.title: Woman arrested and facing felony charges in World War II Memorial vandalism case, DOJ says
headlines.description: A woman accused of vandalizing the World War II Memorial has been arrested in Washington, U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia Jeanine Pirro announced Friday.

headlines.title: Judge shows signs of frustration with DOJ attorneys over handling of Epstein files
headlines.description: The judge said he had “absolutely no desire” to go down the road of holding government attorneys in contempt but gave a history lesson on when he has done so.

headlines.title: Appeals court dodges major ruling on Trump’s contentious use of obscure deportation law
headlines.description: The case focuses on last year’s attempted removal of alleged Tren de Aragua gang members using the 18th century Alien Enemies Act.
